name: Cloth Armor
desc: Well fashioned clothing, suited for most kinds of wear and able to provide slight protection.

stat.special: Well fashioned clothing, suited for most kinds of wear and able to provide slight protection.

name: Leather Armor
desc: Sections of hardened animal hides laid over the body. Leather does not impede much but provides a great deal of protection.

stat.special: Sections of hardened animal hides laid over the body. Leather does not impede much but provides a great deal of protection.

name: Chain and Gambeson
desc: A flexible yet extremely protective network of linked metal rings. Chain impedes movement only a little and rarely breaks.

stat.special: A flexible yet extremely protective network of linked metal rings. Chain impedes movement only a little and rarely breaks.

name: Dragon Armor
desc: The most protective Class of Armor, an overlapping array of metal scales and loops. Its sheer weight is a significant drawback unless the wearer can bear it.

stat.special: The most protective Class of Armor, an overlapping array of metal scales and loops. Its sheer weight is a significant drawback unless the wearer can bear it.

name: Buckler
desc: A small dome of hardened steel fit to the hand, used to deflect more than really obstruct an Attack. Its size allows it to be tempered to a degree unfit for larger Shields, but its size makes it equa…

stat.special:
A small dome of hardened steel fit to the hand, used to deflect more than really obstruct an Attack. Its size allows it to be tempered to a degree unfit for larger Shields, but its size makes it equally unfit for some tasks.
The Hand used to Equip a Buckler is not considered full.
stat.effects: The Hand used to Equip a Buckler is not considered full.

name: Heater
desc: Constructed to affix to cover the side and deflect most blows, Heaters are popular for their middle approach, neither too large nor small.

stat.special: Constructed to affix to cover the side and deflect most blows, Heaters are popular for their middle approach, neither too large nor small.

name: Dragon Shield
desc: Like a wall, the Dragon Shield is a bulwark against nearly anything, but obscenely cumbersome. Its more popular use is to set up emplacements for archers, but some combatants choose to carry them.

stat.special:
Like a wall, the Dragon Shield is a bulwark against nearly anything, but obscenely cumbersome. Its more popular use is to set up emplacements for archers, but some combatants choose to carry them.
Everything in the Shield's Engagement benefits from T Cover, including the wearer. When this Cover causes something to miss, it always Damages the Shield.
